title: Tooth Fairy, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description One-ounce pure silver – a timeless keepsake A symbol of childhood magic and transformation Perfect as a unique gift or collector’s piece Detailed craftsmanship capturing a cherished tradition Tooth Fairy is not just a fairy tale but a symbol of carefree moments and childhood joy. This one-ounce silver coin brings back warm memories of first losses and small rewards that taught us that every change brings something new. It is a unique gift and a keepsake that gains even more value as the years go by.
